content: Elixir optional dependency pattern for libraries: In mix.exs, mark dep as {dep, version, optional: true}. In library code, guard with Code.ensure_loaded?(Module) at compile time. Common pattern: defmodule Adapter do ... only if Code.ensure_loaded?(Ecto) end. Orkestra already uses this for amqp and spear adapters. Ecto/postgrex will be optional: true in Orkestra's mix.exs, and Orkestra.Projection.Adapters.Ecto will only compile when Ecto is available. The consuming app must add ecto/ecto_sql/postgrex to their deps.
